facts.fact: The companion page to the 2026 finance law (promulgated 16 January 2026) records that, hand-checked across Article 11 and the full ministry classification, the law carries no identity or data-exchange line at any grain, naming no population register or CRVS system, and no named IT system anywhere.
facts.system: CRVS / population register (no line in the Loi de Finances 2026)

note: The fact is a stated absence of a named domestic budget line for a civil registration system; finance:not-stated is the nearest value in the closed list and the parent may drop it. The rest of the document is the digital ministry's vote and tax-code provisions.
